messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: routing-service.p99_latency > 1.0s for the last 3 minutes across us-west-2 / eu-west-1. Auto-notify oncall. Severity: P1

maria (oncall): seeing it too. p95 ~ 320ms, p99 ~ 1.1-1.5s, streaming stalls spiking to ~18%. Starting triage. @eng-router can you confirm recent routing-policy rollout? :rotating_light:

eng-router: pushed routing-policy:v3.2.4 ~35m ago, intended to shift traffic to shard-aware local affinity to reduce cross-zone hops. No rollouts after that. No known infra deploys.

kevin: checking LB logs and shard distribution now. Initial quick glance shows a small subset of shards getting >60% of traffic in eu-west-1. Might be hot partitioning + new policy weighting.

raj: pulling telemetry dashboard -> `service.routing.*` and stream tail. Running query: `sum(rate(requests[1m])) by (shard, region)`

infra-bot: quick snapshot: total qps stable, but shard-047 and shard-119 in eu-west-1 are at 3-4x typical latency and show retransmits and partial responses in streaming connections.

maria (oncall): support-team, any customer reports?

support-team: multiple customers reporting streaming stalls and partial responses, some 504s for long responses. Not yet escalated to legal/enterprise SLA but we have three customers with degraded UX. Sending proactive comms now.

eng-router: sharing config diff from rollout:
```
- routing-policy: prefer-local: false
+ routing-policy: prefer-local: true
  affinity-weight: 0.7
  fallback: eager
```
We tried to reduce cross-zone latency but looks like weights created hot shards in certain zones.

maria (oncall): hypothesis: policy change concentrated keys to small shard set in eu-west, causing queueing and KV cache thrash for streaming. Need mitigation: revert policy OR roll traffic away from hot shards.

kevin: I can push a rollback of routing-policy to v3.2.3 (previous stable) but that takes ~3-5m to propagate and will reshuffle assignments. We should canary rollback to eu-west-1 first.

raj: agree. Also we can temporarily reduce affinity-weight to 0.4 to spread across more shards quickly, which is a config flip that applies faster. Options: (A) affinity-weight -> 0.4 (fast), (B) full rollback (safer but slower).

maria (oncall): do A now and prepare B if no improvement in 5m. Kevin, execute A and post commands you run.

kevin: doing A. Command:
```
ctl-router update-policy --region eu-west-1 --affinity-weight 0.4 --policy prefer-local=true
```
Applying...

infra-bot: policy change accepted, propagation started to edge routers.

maria (oncall): monitoring. p95 -> 280ms, p99 -> 900ms. Streaming stalls dropped to ~12%. improvement but still abnormal.

eng-router: hot shards still 2-3x, but load is rebalancing. We should also enable eager fallback on streaming for this region to avoid stalls (deliver partial chunk + retry). That is lower-risk.

kevin: enabling streaming fallback for eu-west-1 now: `ctl-router set-fallback --region eu-west-1 --streaming-mode partial-retry`

infra-bot: fallback mode enabled.

maria (oncall): good. p95 240ms, p99 550-700ms, streaming stalls 6-8%. Customers still seeing intermittent degraded sessions but much improved.

support-team: update: one customer (prod-azula) experiencing resumed stalls for long (>8s) generation streams. They've been notified; we recommend switching them to a dedicated route if they need strict SLOs.

raj: for long-term root cause we need to audit the policy weighting logic. There's a bug in the balancing heuristic that undercounts shard capacity for shards with recently updated KV caches, so the calc over-weights them. filing bug.

eng-router: filing internal issue: RB-2913 "weight calc ignores cache-warm state -> hot shard over-assignment". Assigning to @kevin and @barbara for fix.

barbara: ack. I have a small patch that changes estimator to incorporate recent cache-hit ratio. Will validate and can propose a canary for the next rolling deploy.

maria (oncall): action items and timeline: (1) immediate: affinity-weight -> 0.4 (done), streaming fallback enabled (done) — mitigated to acceptable levels; (2) next 12h: patch estimator + canary rollout; (3) follow-up: consider rollout gating when shard imbalance > 2x; (4) support to continue customer comms.

kevin: created rollback runbook note and a quick script to move heavy keys off hot shards if we need emergency drain: `drain-hot-shard --shard 047 --migrate=keys --limit=1000s` — keep as last resort.

maria (oncall): handing off to raj for overnight tracking. I'll update incident with summary for postmortem. Raj, you're oncall for next shift. :wave:

raj: taking over. I'll monitor p99 and customer impact board, and coordinate with barbara on the estimator patch. If p99 > 900ms for 10m, escalate back to livepage.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Severity lowered to P2. Mitigations applied: affinity-weight adjusted, streaming fallback enabled. Customer impact: degraded UX for subset of streaming customers; no confirmed SLA breaches at this time.

maria (oncall): thanks team. saved logs/queries in #incidents/3423456789-archive. Will write a short blameless postmortem template with timeline and probable root cause.

support-team: added proactive notes to impacted customers.
